yearly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_wp35_bri_yearly_pulse
		oe_wp35_bri_letters_patent_yearly_pulse
	}
}

on_ending_war = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_wp35_bri_letters_patent_war_ended
	}
}

oe_wp35_bri_yearly_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		current_year >= 1337
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }
		oe_wp35_bri_participant = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { oe_wp35_bri_is_britain = yes }
			oe_wp35_bri_backfill_unlocks = yes
			oe_wp35_bri_name_east_india_company = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_wp35_bri_diwani_holder }
			oe_wp35_bri_refresh_diwani = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				oe_wp35_bri_is_britain = yes
				has_variable = oe_wp35_bri_crown_rule
			}
			oe_wp35_bri_refresh_crown_rule = yes
		}
	}
}

oe_wp35_bri_letters_patent_yearly_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		current_year >= 1337
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }
		oe_wp35_bri_letters_patent_holder = yes
	}
	effect = {
		oe_wp35_bri_refresh_letters_patent = yes
	}
}

oe_wp35_bri_letters_patent_war_ended = {
	trigger = {
		current_year >= 1337
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { oe_wp35_bri_letters_patent_holder = yes }
			oe_wp35_bri_refresh_letters_patent = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = oe_wp35_is_british_india
				overlord ?= { oe_wp35_bri_letters_patent_holder = yes }
			}
			overlord = { oe_wp35_bri_refresh_letters_patent = yes }
		}
	}
}
